title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Documents Requests: Allowance for Documents Only a Public Agency Issues
content:
**Rule.** On a documents request under the Patient Financial Assistance Program, an agency allowance is added to the response days for documents only a public agency issues: a household with no active coverage on file whose recorded percent is at or below its tier's Medicaid screening line adds the Medicaid screening days, 15 days, since it must show a Medicaid application or denial; a household with no active coverage on file whose tier has no screening line or whose recorded percent is above it adds the uninsured days, 5 days; any other household adds none.

**Terms.** "Active coverage on file" means a coverage of the household in active status in Insurance Coverage & Claims. The "recorded percent" is the percent of the poverty guideline recorded on the case when the request is issued. The tier's Medicaid screening line is:

| Tier of the case | Medicaid screening line |
|---|---|
| Financial Assistance 25% Discount | None (0) |
| Financial Assistance 50% Discount | None (0) |
| Financial Assistance 75% Discount | None (0) |
| Financial Assistance Full Discount | 138 percent |
| Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount | None (0) |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment | None (0) |

## Decision table

| Active coverage on file | Tier has a screening line | Recorded percent against the line | Agency allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | Yes | At or below the line | 15 days |
| None | Yes | Above the line | 5 days |
| None | No | Not read | 5 days |
| At least one | Not read | Not read | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; case at the Financial Assistance Full Discount, no active coverage)

- Recorded percent 138.0: at the line, 15 days.
- Recorded percent 138.1: above the line, 5 days.
- The same household at the Financial Assistance 75% Discount, which has no screening line: 5 days whatever its recorded percent.
